name: Fluid type dissolve and resolve

source.description: 1 inspected reference film (batch-3, 2026-11-26): a transformation reel pulls a word apart into ink streaks and lets it settle back.

technique: Turbulent ink pulls a word apart into streaks and then settles back into the word, so the type seems made of the same matter as the scene. A word's arrival or departure becomes a material event.
purpose: Make a word's arrival or departure a material event: the type seems made of the same matter as the scene.
visual_behaviour: Turbulent ink billows, pulls a word apart into streaks, then settles back into the clean word.
mechanics: Pre-rendered fluid simulation (yellow and grey ink on black) with the word as a collider or initial density, about 2.5 s of billowing (ref-19cee08f9c 8.0-10.4 s); the clean word sharpens over the ink at 9.3-9.5 s, distorts into streaks 10.40-10.90 s and re-forms 10.96-11.29 s. Composite the plate under a clean HyperFrames word for the settled frames.

decomposition.timing: Dissolve about 0.5 s; re-form about 0.35 s; ink section about 3 s.

parameters.name: reform
parameters.description: Seconds from streaks back to the word

use_cases: Title words in a brand or art piece
failure_modes: The word is unreadable for too long
Simulations are heavy and not deterministic in a browser; use a plate

implementation.approach: A pre-rendered fluid plate (Blender, through scripts/visual-director.py add-plate) with the word as collider or initial density, placed as a timed video layer; the clean word stays live text in HyperFrames for the settled frames (plates never carry text that must read). Simulation in the browser is heavy and not deterministic.

additional_tooling.justification: A fluid simulation needs a Blender plate; HyperFrames composites it under live text.

provenance.observed: Ink billows after a burst (8.0-10.4 s), pulls a word apart into streaks (10.40-10.90 s) and settles back into it (10.96-11.29 s).

licensing_notes: Technique only, learned from user-supplied references (inspiration-only, rights unknown).
